_what: Plan item 4.2: the fix-from-house outcome suite. Ten closed reports issues, each replayed against the repository as it was when the issue was filed (base_sha), in a clean container, by the skill under test; graded by the tests the real fix added and by the reviewer gate. Fill each entry in at the retro that first runs the suite: the reports issue number, the merged PR that fixed it, and that PR's base commit. Leave an entry's numbers null until then; the suite runs only entries with all three set. See README.md for the procedure.
pass_rule: An entry passes when the replayed fix makes every test in `grading_tests` pass, changes no line of a test that existed at base_sha, passes devloop-guard from base_sha, and gets `approve` from the reviewer gate. The suite's score is pass^3 (an entry passes only when all three replays pass).
